_note: Title formats for the 0006 Format Library. A title can match several formats. 'fits_us' = a faceless data/anime channel can make it without match footage or a presenter. Regexes are Python, case-insensitive. Edit freely; hit rates are recomputed every run.

formats.name: The Rise and Fall of X
formats.why: A full arc in four words: success the viewer knows, plus a collapse they want explained.

formats.name: What Happened to X
formats.why: Curiosity gap about a name the viewer remembers; the answer feels owed.

formats.name: How Good Was X (Actually/Really)
formats.why: Settles a debate with evidence; 'actually' promises a verdict against the hype.

formats.name: Why X ...
formats.why: Explains a known outcome; the viewer already has the question.

formats.name: How X Became/Destroyed/Changed Y
formats.why: Mechanism story: a known result plus the hidden path to it.

formats.name: The Day/Night/Match X ...
formats.why: One vivid event as a story; specific and cinematic.

formats.name: The Player/Club/Team Who/That ...
formats.why: A single protagonist defined by one extraordinary fact.

formats.name: (Famous) Footballers/Players Who ...
formats.why: A collection defined by a surprising shared trait; many faces, one hook.

formats.name: Most / Highest / Oldest X (data list)
formats.why: Pure data payoff: a ranked answer to a 'who is the most...' question.

formats.name: N Players/Moments That ...
formats.why: Countable promise; viewers know the length and stay for #1.

formats.name: Tier List / Ranking Every X
formats.why: Opinion with structure; invites argument in comments.

formats.name: X vs Y (comparison)
formats.why: Head-to-head debate; the viewer picks a side before clicking.

formats.name: What If X ...
formats.why: Hypothetical the viewer can't resolve alone; data simulation fits.

formats.name: Is X Better/the GOAT? (question)
formats.why: An open debate framed as a question the video answers.

formats.name: X Explained
formats.why: Promises clarity on something confusing; search-friendly.

formats.name: The (Untold) Story / Truth About X
formats.why: Promises the full narrative or a hidden side of a known name.

formats.name: Hidden / Secret / Nobody Talks About
formats.re: \b(hidden|secret|nobody talks about|no one talks about|nobody noticed|forgotten|you never knew|didn't know)\b
formats.why: Insider knowledge; the viewer fears missing what others know.

formats.name: Shocked the World / Changed Football Forever
formats.re: \b(shocked the world|changed (football|the game|everything)|forever|destroyed|humiliated|broke the internet|nobody saw coming|unstoppable)\b
formats.why: Stakes and scale in one phrase.

formats.name: I Scouted / I Tried / I Watched Every ...
formats.why: Personal effort as proof; needs a creator identity (a voice persona could carry it).

formats.name: If You Don't Understand X, You Don't Understand Y
formats.why: Trinder's format: an unfamiliar mechanism tied to an outcome viewers want.

formats.name: The New Era of X / About to Change Forever
formats.re: \bnew era\b|\babout to change\b|\bnobody (even )?realizes\b|\bis over\b|\bthe end of\b
formats.why: Shift narrative; urgency that the world is changing now.

formats.name: Overrated / Underrated
formats.why: Contrarian verdict; invites disagreement.

formats.name: Goals / Skills / Highlights compilation
formats.re: \b(all goals|top 10 goals|skills (&|and) goals|best goals|best skills|goals (&|and) assists|every goal)\b
formats.why: Footage compilations; not replicable without match footage.

formats.name: X Reacts to Y
formats.why: Reaction content; needs a presenter and footage.

formats.name: Guess the Player / Quiz
formats.why: Interactive; viewers play along, high retention.
